# v0.33.0

## Highlights

This release features 927 commits from 389 contributors (122 new)!

* **New models**: Reflection Beam-1.0 (501B MoE, 23B active) with its DFlash2 drafter (#62074), Yandex AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B (#57963), Recursive Flint (40B MoE, 2.5B active) (#62938), Muse Spark Open (#61879), Step-5 Preview (#61727, #63147), NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super (#62957), Nemotron-Labs Dory1.0-4B (#60149), Nemotron Parse 3.5 (#61651), MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 (#63095), Domyn Edge (#62544) and the ColUltraVBERT visual document retriever (#62237).
* **PyTorch 2.14**: vLLM is upgraded to PyTorch 2.14.0, with torchvision 0.29.0 and Triton 3.8.0 (#52183).
* **CUDA 12.9 dropped**: release wheels and images are CUDA 13.0 only. The CUDA 12.9 wheels and the `-cu129` / `-cu129-ubuntu2404` images are no longer published (#62575); use the default CUDA 13.0 artifacts instead.
* **libtorch ABI stable CUDA wheel**: the CUDA wheel is now ABI stable with libtorch.
* **AWS EFA image**: a new `vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0-efa` image (x86_64 and aarch64) bundles the AWS EFA libraries and the EFA build of the Mooncake transfer engine, for KV transfer and multi-node serving on EFA-enabled EC2 instances (#58768).
* **`vllm/vllm` image alias**: every release image is now also published under the shorter `vllm/vllm` name, e.g. `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0`, `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-efa` and `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-rocm`.
* **Speculative decoding**: the new XPress refiner for block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash and DSpark (#54448); FLy, an opt-in lossy verification policy with 1.04-1.31x decode throughput on MI355X and B300 (#53987); DFlash/DSpark no longer reserve draft slots in the token budget, taking DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + DSpark on GB300 from 1373 to 3390 output tok/s in the PR's benchmark (#59468); quantized draft `lm_head` (`draft_lm_head_quantization`, +18% decode at concurrency 1) (#59973); lookahead block hashes so EAGLE/MTP prefix-cache hits keep their last block, on by default (#61589); and MTP drafts in the Transformers modeling backend (#61270).
* **Faster decode on NVIDIA**: opt-in latency-specialized decode on GB300 for Kimi-K3 (1.5-2x at TP8/TP16, #61867) and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (18.3% faster decode step at batch 1, #61868); DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 MXFP4 experts run as block FP8 through Humming on Hopper (+9-21% decode on 4x H200, #61875); FA4 sparse MLA decode on Blackwell (#55866); FlashInfer DCP prefill on trtllm-gen with 39-48% lower mean TTFT at 100k input on 8xB200 (#62029); and decode-only full CUDA graphs under MRV2 prefill context parallelism (2.6x over eager, #62377).
* **AMD ROCm**: the default ROCm image and wheels move to ROCm 10.0, with ROCm 7.2 still published as `-rocm72` (#58761); MonoKernel decode via `--monokernel` for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on MI300X/MI325X (2.32x P50 interactivity at concurrency 1, #60731) and on every MI355X layer (#61082), and for MiniMax-M3-MXFP4 on MI355X (16.6% lower TPOT, #62712, #62994); the `ROCM_OCTAVE` 3-4 bit KV cache (4.6x the KV tokens of fp16 on RX 7900 XTX, #59774); and gfx1250 enablement for gpt-oss-120b, DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V4-Flash and MiniMax-M3 (#58800).
* **API and serving**: the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/decisions` endpoint, on by default for supported generation models (#60465, #61550); token embeddings with optional late chunking on `/v1/embeddings` (#61772, #63051, #60164); `output_mode="derender"` on `/inference/v1/generate` (#60082); a large Rust frontend parity push, including no more HTTP 500 on long conversations (#62374) and unsupported flags failing at startup (#62431); concurrent worker startup with TP > 1 (#60028); and a watchdog that dumps stack traces from stuck engine and worker processes (#55700).
* **Breaking changes**: Medusa and the MLP speculator removed (#61701); the legacy Ray compiled-graph executor removed (#61712, #62228); `--mamba-cache-mode` deprecated (#60043); requests sent while generation is paused now get HTTP 503 (#51488); the NIXL connector needs NIXL 1.5 or newer (#61032); LM Format Enforcer and `--ir-op-priority` deprecated (#63423, #63371).

## Release Artifacts

<!-- TODO: verify every URL and tag after publishing (wheels.vllm.ai/rocm/0.33.0/, wheels.vllm.ai/0.33.0/xpu, Docker Hub tags, GitHub release assets). -->

### Python Wheels

| Platform | Install |
|---|---|
| PyPI (CUDA 13.0) | `pip install vllm` |
| PyPI (CUDA 13.0, uv) | `uv pip install vllm --torch-backend=auto` |
| ROCm 10.0 | `pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/rocm/0.33.0/rocm100` |
| ROCm 7.2 | `pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/rocm/0.33.0/rocm72` |
| XPU | `uv pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/0.33.0/xpu --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/xpu --index-strategy unsafe-best-match` |

### Docker Images

| Platform | Docker Image |
|---|---|
| CUDA 13.0 (Default) | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0` |
| CUDA 13.0 + AWS EFA | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0-efa` |
| ROCm 10.0 | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.33.0` |
| ROCm 7.2 | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.33.0-rocm72` |
| CPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-cpu:v0.33.0` |
| XPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:v0.33.0` |

Every image is also available under the shorter `vllm/vllm` name: `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0`, `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-efa`, `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-rocm` (`-rocm100`, `-rocm72`), `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-cpu` and `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-xpu`. `latest` works the same way, e.g. `vllm/vllm:latest-rocm`.

### Other Artifacts

Pre-built release artifacts are available in the **Assets** section at the bottom of this page, including:
- Source distribution tarball
- CUDA 13.0 Python wheels for x86_64 and arm64
- CPU Python wheels for x86_64, arm64, and macOS
- XPU Python wheel for x86_64

## Model Support
* **New models**: Reflection Beam-1.0 (`BeamForCausalLM`) day-0 support with its DFlash2 drafter and fused Blackwell kernels (#62074, #62042), plus `beam` reasoning and tool parsers (#62052); Yandex AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B (Kimi Delta Attention hybrid, 512-expert MoE, 262K context) (#57963); Recursive Flint BF16 and NVFP4 GGUF checkpoints with small-batch Blackwell decode kernels (#62938); Muse Spark Open (#61879) with reasoning and tool parsers (#62207); Step-5 Preview (#61727, #62126, #62132), running on SM100 (#63147) with LoRA (#62498); NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super (#62957); Nemotron-Labs Dory1.0-4B (#60149); Nemotron Parse 3.5 with an MTP proposer on MRV2 (#61651); MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 (#63095); Domyn Edge (#62544); ColUltraVBERT (#62237); LFM2.5-Embedding-350M (`Lfm2BidirectionalModel`, #62201); Kolibri 1 through the Transformers backend (#60827); and Decision 3.0 models (#61565, #61778) and Cloudflare Clef-Flash (#61308) on `/v1/systemone`.
* **DeepSeek-V4 and V4.1**: length-aware decode indexer block selection (about 850 us saved per step at 1M context, #61039); MegaMoE experts loaded directly in the DeepGEMM layout so `reload_weights` works (#60096); `fused_wqa_wkv` split by token across TP on SM90 (#58872); MegaAttn `wo_a` writes MXFP8 input for `wo_b` (#60118); native small-head FlashMLA sparse prefill on SM90 (#61615); FlashMLA interleaved KV layout (#61371); redundant EPLB expert slots loaded (#59611); GPU Engram tables read from peer HBM, fixing DEP decode hangs on GB200 (#62091); and fixes for Engram under PP (#62208), Engram all-to-all hangs (#62269), prefill index-workspace NaNs (#60613), C128 compressed-KV writes under PIECEWISE graphs (#59709), routed-expert rows under replay (#61643, #62652) and the updated 1017 reference encoding (#62199, #62200).
* **GLM**: GLM-5.3-Flash defaults to an FP8 KV cache (9.8% higher end-to-end throughput in the PR's benchmark, #61228) and gets mHC TileLang decode kernels on Blackwell (#62745); GLM-5.3 per-token-group quant (2.8% ITL, #60927), in-place draft decode metadata (#61873) and skipped `concat_and_cache_mla` scales (1.2-3.0% TPOT on B300, #62102); FP8 indexer WK pairs kept across `load_weights` calls, fixing thinking loops with runai_streamer (#59223).
* **Kimi-K3**: KDA RecoverSSM CuTe DSL verify/commit kernels on SM10x, with verify records moved out of the KV cache so KV connectors work (#63045); online quantization of NVIDIA projections (#62980).
* **Qwen**: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 QSA KV cache on Ampere (#60602, #60992), packed NVFP4 PLE embeddings that fit Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 on one DGX Spark (#56273) and PLE short-conv prefill checkpoints (#61601); FlashInfer GDN prefill checkpoints for Qwen3-Next / Qwen3.5 (#60050).
* **Other models**: Cohere2MoE attention/MoE dual stream, single TP all-reduce and fused add + RMSNorm (1.14-1.36x TPOT, on by default, #62101); Beam TP all-reduce fused with norms and MoE finalize (#62366); MiniMax-M3 CUTLASS MSA decode crossover (#55838); Granite MoE as an EAGLE3/DFlash/DSpark target (#61110); NemotronHMTP sharing target embeddings (#62194); LoRA for BERT cross-encoders and token classification (#61279, #61391).
* **Multimodal**: PaddleOCR-VL batched vision encoder (34-85% more throughput, #61458) and `compile_mm_encoder` (#61838); DeepSeek-VL2 ViT full CUDA graphs (#46005); Gemma4Unified batched embedding (#60643); Pixtral real-valued RoPE under compile (#63145); and fixes for EXAONE-4.5 images (broken since v0.29.0, #61104), Gemma 4 encoder graphs (#61365, #60687, #63538), DeepSeek-VL2 encoder cache and PP (#63120, #63192) and Gemma 4 placeholders (#61196).
* **Transformers modeling backend**: MTP speculative drafts (#61270), fused post-top-k MoE routers (#57410), graph caching instead of AOT caching (#58918) and dynamic-RoPE CUDA graphs (#58064).

## Engine Core
* **Speculative decoding**: XPress (#54448), FLy (#53987), no draft-slot budget reservation for DFlash/DSpark (#59468), quantized draft `lm_head` (#59973), lookahead block hashes (#61589), MRV2 skipping drafts no request can use (up to 7.3% prefill throughput with DFlash, #62784), Triton split-K verify (#56148), varlen Mamba2 decode for adaptive verification (#53036), and fixes for stop-trimmed token counts (#58668), block verification randomness (#61161), MTP block tables (#61174), grammar masks (#52477), EAGLE SWA prefix hits (#62206), DFlash/DSpark Mamba checkpoint reuse (#54163) and PP warmup (#62129).
* **Model Runner V2**: batch-sharded sampling for GPT-OSS (#61257) with adaptive verification (#58466), 31-120x faster long-prompt staged writes on GB200 (#62698), encoder towers skipped on later PP stages (0.58-1.27 GiB per stage, #60238), async scheduling kept for ngram (#62521), `input_ids` on later PP stages (#61016), and memory-profiling fixes (#57926, #58243, #61509, #63431).
* **Sampling**: Triton top-k/top-p skips the cutoff search for masked logits (up to about 8x, #61213); small-batch split top-p (1.22-2.70x on B300, #61996); and fixes for huge logits and boundary ties (#58231, #62046).
* **Startup and reliability**: concurrent local worker startup with TP > 1 (about 50s saved at TP8, #60028); shared Triton JIT compile pool (9-28% faster cold warmup, #61422); engine and worker watchdog (#55700); libgomp fork deadlock fixed (#62884); Fast Start with expert parallelism (#55490) and daemon fixes (#62583, #63451, #63088, #62734, #63506); and SHM broadcast reader memory growth fixed (#63165).
* **Memory and performance**: UVA-offloaded MoE experts on the sorted fused-MoE path (+7-19%, #62054); DispatchPooler bypass for homogeneous pooling (up to 10.3%, #62940); linear-time encoder cache free (#62850); sliding-window block tables null freed entries (#60767).
* **LoRA**: expert LoRA for MXFP4 MoE on `flashinfer_trtllm` (#61979), text-only LoRAs on multimodal wrappers (#62224), unsupported models rejected at validation (#61884), and fixes for `load_inplace` reloads (#41482), `max_loras` accounting (#60306), SM90 `lora_expand` NaNs (#61906) and wake-up from level-2 sleep (#62358).
* **RL**: per-choice `return_weight_versions` (#61347), NCCL M2N transfer with per-parameter meshes (#60934), parameter metadata sent once (#35911), the `ParamMeta` / `iter_full()` / `iter_local()` weight-transfer API (#63256), and a silent MoE weight corruption fix with packed NCCL transfer plus layerwise reload (#62555).
* **Batch invariance**: compressed-tensors W4A16/W8A16 (#60524), GateLinear routers (#59985), online FP8 MoE (#57092), and inductor batch-invariant mode under `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT` (#61118).

## Large Scale Serving
* **Context parallelism**: MRV2 PCP decode full CUDA graphs (#62377); PCP for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with prefix caching and SWA bounded replay (#59857, #62183, #62384); FlashInfer DCP prefill on trtllm-gen (#62029); direct DCP all-to-all with strided LSE (#60373); FlashMLA sparse on the a2a DCP backend (#61285).
* **HiSparse**: direct reads of GPU-resident KV, fixing OOM with long prompts and a 3.3x slowdown on 1M-token prefill (#60417); faster host pool prefault (#60869); and P/D correctness fixes (#61659, #62739, #63827).
* **KV connectors**: NIXL 1.5 strided descriptors (#61032), sleep mode with the pull connector (#59635), mixed hybrid MLA block sizes (#61002) and GQA draft head sharding (#58471); Mooncake sleep mode over RDMA (#59625) and Prometheus metrics (#56939); MoRIIO hybrid and heterogeneous-TP WRITE transfers (#60544, #61726); streaming responses carry `kv_transfer_params` (#40186); fault tolerance extended to P/D, fixing KV block leaks (#56430).
* **KV offload**: CPU offload over up to 32 shm files (GLM-5.3 offload startup 63.6 s to 38.3 s, #59546), opt-in same-step small loads (#61961), EAGLE/MTP partial tails in align mode (#61019), lock/unlock and off-thread tiering (#58168), and many correctness fixes (#63266, #60810, #63652, #62929, #63010, #60574, #63655).
* **MoE and DP**: DeepEP-v2 fused decode globalize+align (up to 2.01x on H200 EP32, #53911); Elastic EP with an external load balancer (#43202); low-latency CPU all-reduce for DP syncs (#61767) and a DP wave hang fix (#59559); EPLB fixes for MXFP4/MXFP8 scales (#61786) and NIXL reads (#62081).

## Hardware & Performance
* **NVIDIA**: Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash latency-specialized decode on GB300 (#61867, #61868); FA4 sparse MLA decode (#55866); opt-in CuTe DSL MLA context prefill (#62069); DeepGEMM MegaMoE with NVFP4 routed experts (#61538) and warmed-up kernels (#60468, #61657); Triton GDN decode tuned on SM100 (#61355); GLM-5.2/5.3 low-latency BF16 GEMM on SM107 (#62843); pre-SM90 FlashInfer spec decode in full CUDA graphs (73.6 to 108.1 tok/s on SM80, #60532); `cooperative_topk` sized by row length (#62171); fused GDN MTP decode for SM80-SM90 in CUDA 12.x builds (#60896); and DGX Spark Qwen4Exp TP2 plans (#61437).
* **AMD ROCm**: ROCm 10.0 default image (#58761); MonoKernel decode for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and V4-Pro and MiniMax-M3 (#60731, #61082, #61482, #62712, #62994); `ROCM_OCTAVE` KV cache (#59774); gfx1250 enablement (#58800); DeepSeek-V4 MXFP4 indexer K cache by default on CDNA4 (up to 30.7% lower TTFT, #60834, #63669); AITER MegaMoE fixed-slot dispatch (14-15%, #61262) and shared-expert overlap (#61819); Kimi-K3 Gluon KDA kernels (#57392, #59552) and specialized decode (#60683); Qwen3.5 fused GDN MTP decode (+10-16% on MI350X, #61855); Qwen3.8-Flash-Next native W4A4 (1.9-2.3x, #60816); AITER top-k for sparse indexers on gfx950 (#61943); FlyDSL GDN prefill default on gfx942/gfx950 (#60645); RDNA3 TRITON_ATTN addressing restored (about 18%, #60084); and a MiniMax-M3-MXFP4 startup fix for very large GEMMs (#64567).
* **Intel XPU**: SYCL GDN prefill backend selection (#56835), torch MXFP4 linear backend (#51965), SYCL FlashAttention for prefix-LM text batches (#62014) and NIXL 1.5.0 in the image (#60356).
* **CPU**: zentorch 2.14.0.1 with float16 on Zen CPUs with AVX512-FP16 (#61411); MRV2 Triton warmup at startup removing an 11-20 s first-request compile (#62888); INT8 W8A8 MoE brgemm (#60740); hybrid-model prefix caching (#61805); and Run:ai Model Streamer in the CPU image (#61382).
* **Other**: tpu-inference v0.32.0 with torch 2.14.0 (#63080) and more out-of-tree platform hooks (#62026, #63017, #63601, #63457).

## Quantization
* Humming runs DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 MXFP4 experts as block FP8 on Hopper (#61875) and honors `--quantization-config.moe.activation` (#62751); pluggable KV cache data types (#52670); online re-quantization extended to NVFP4 MoE (#60276); Quark MXFP8 routed experts (#63125); MoNe expert-pruning checkpoints (#50415); torch MXFP8 linear backend (#51933); FP8 per-token-group quant 1.15-1.29x faster (#61343); Cosmos3-Edge ModelOpt FP8 (#57393); and a Nemotron-3-Nano NVFP4 garbage-output fix under torch.compile (#61749).

## API & Frontend
* **New endpoints and options**: `/v1/decisions` (#60465, #61550); token embeddings and late chunking (#61772, #63051, #60164); `output_mode="derender"` (#60082); `--reasoning-effort-map` (#61094); `--sleep-mode-backend` (#63138); dynamic profiler options on `/start_profile` (#51974); images on `/v1/systemone` (#62181, #62437); Responses `max_tool_calls` (#47112) and prompt-cache fields (#62856); and `/openapi.json` response schemas (#60926).
* **Tool calling and reasoning**: linear-time streaming tool arguments for GLM, Gemma 4, Qwen3 XML (2.1 s to 11 ms for a 12 KB call) and MiniMax M2 (#61253, #61494, #62027, #62035); DeepSeek V3 multi-line arguments (#60362); structured output masks grammar-invalid reasoning ends instead of returning 500 (#61574).
* **Behavior**: chat `finish_reason` and Responses `status` reflect what happened (#59324); beam search normalizes by generated length so `length_penalty` applies (#62928); automatic truncation reserves one generation token (#62010).
* **Rust frontend**: `--trust-request-chat-template` (#62673), `--return-tokens-as-token-ids` (#63318), `--tokenizer` options (#62416), `--custom-histogram-buckets` (#62826) and per-request metrics (#59314); request and response parity with the Python frontend (#62434, #62425, #62426, #62427, #62428, #61949, #62429, #62822, #62663); and the MiniJinja fuel limit only on request-supplied templates (#62374).

## Security
* Per-request budgets for downloaded and decoded media bytes (#61226); speculators checkpoint metadata can no longer reference local verifier paths (#61587); `certifi>=2026.10.19` and refreshed CA certificates (#62868); raised floors for aiohttp, Pillow, MCP and multidict (#62835).

## Dependencies
* PyTorch 2.14.0, torchvision 0.29.0, Triton 3.8.0 (#52183).
* FlashInfer 0.7.2.post1 (#60948, #61913, #63466), humming-kernels 0.1.19 (#62816, #64802), DeepGEMM 2.8.1 and later pins (#61149, #61744, #63253), FlashMLA 2026.09.30 (#61371), TokenSpeed MLA 2.0.3 (#61125, #61689), `nvidia-cudnn-frontend>=1.31.0` (#61465), NIXL 1.5.0 (#60428, #60356) and LMCache 0.5.6 (#62835).
* ROCm: AITER v0.1.26 (#61697, #62486) and UCX v1.23.0-rc1 (#62827). CPU: zentorch 2.14.0.1 (#61411). TPU: tpu-inference v0.32.0 (#63080).

## Build
* Release wheels and images are CUDA 13.0 only (#62575); new `vllm-openai-efa` Docker target (#58768); ROCm 10.0 is the default ROCm image with ROCm 7.2 as `-rocm72` (#58761); ROCm wheel builds about 4-7x faster (#63105).

## Breaking Changes & Deprecations
* CUDA 12.9 wheels and images are no longer published (#62575).
* Medusa and the MLP speculator were removed (#61701). The legacy Ray compiled-graph executor was removed and `VLLM_USE_RAY_V2_EXECUTOR_BACKEND` is gone; `RayExecutorV2` is the only Ray executor (#61712, #62228).
* Deprecated: `--mamba-cache-mode` (no effect, #60043), `--ir-op-priority` (removal in v0.34.0, #63371), and the LM Format Enforcer structured-output backend (opt-in in v0.34.0, removal in v0.35.0, #63423).
* API changes: requests sent while generation is paused return HTTP 503 (#51488); `kv_transfer_params` / `ec_transfer_params` moved to the top level of render output (#61241); LoRA on a model without LoRA support fails at validation (#61884); the RL weight-transfer API now uses `ParamMeta`, `iter_full()` and `iter_local()` (#63256); beam search scores are normalized by generated length (#62928).
* Rust frontend: unsupported `vllm serve` flags and request fields fail instead of being ignored (#62431, #62434); request-supplied chat templates need `--trust-request-chat-template` (#62673); an empty `tools` array returns 400 (#63060).
* The NIXL connector requires NIXL 1.5 or newer (#61032).
* Removed env vars: `VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MLA_DCP_VERIFY` (#61628), `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM` (#61278) and `VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MEGA_MOE_FUSE_SHARED_EXPERTS` (#61345); `VLLM_ROCM_MONO_DECODE` is replaced by `--monokernel` (#61082).
* New defaults: GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 KV cache (#61228); lookahead block hashes for EAGLE/MTP prefix caching (#61589); Cohere2MoE dual stream (#62101); FA4 sparse MLA decode at 16 or fewer query heads per rank on Blackwell (#55866); ROCm: AITER FP8/FP4 BMM for MLA off (#53123), FlyDSL GDN prefill (#60645), AITER `topk_gating` (#56226), `rms_norm_gated` (#60250) and MXFP4 indexer K cache on CDNA4 for DeepSeek-V4 (#63669).

body:
# v0.32.0

## Highlights

This release features 814 commits from 363 contributors (121 new)!

* **Structured decisions and generic parsers**: the new `POST /v1/systemone` endpoint answers `choice`, `noul` and `score` questions over a structured state (#59299), is served by default (#60677, #60696), and also runs on `Cloudflare/clef-omni` (#61064), `LiquidAI/d1-3B` (#60676) and DiffusionGemma (#60466). The new `hf` tool and reasoning parser (`--tool-call-parser hf`, `--reasoning-parser hf`) reads the checkpoint's `response_template`, so models that ship it need no model-specific parser (#58604, #58602), in both the Python and Rust frontends (#59005).
* **Low-precision KV cache everywhere**: NVFP4 KV cache now runs on SM8x and SM12x (#46963), SM90 (#60620) and with XQA decode on SM12x (#60452), and on MiniMax-M3 sparse attention on SM100 (#59300); GLM-5.x defaults to an FP8 KV cache on SM100, halving KV memory per rank with 2.3-5.5% more throughput at a 7-11% TTFT cost in the PR's benchmark (#60140, #60281); `fp8_ds_mla` on SM90 gives GLM-5.3-Flash up to 31% more output throughput (#59246); ROCm gains the 4-bit `ultraquant_4bit` KV cache with about 2x the density of FP8 (#57057).
* **Model Runner V2**: a GPU n-gram speculator with variable-length drafts (#40704), Elastic EP (#53934), pipeline parallelism with prefill context parallelism for MLA models (#59139), a stock torch.compile mode (#59079), and MRV2 is now the default on ROCm with the model-specific MRV1 exceptions removed (#56360).
* **Faster startup and serving**: `vllm download-kernels` installs FlashInfer's precompiled kernels (#58765); `vllm preload --preload-autotune` keeps the FlashInfer autotune table warm across restarts (#60085); a shared-memory tensor arena broadcasts large multimodal tensors to workers with one copy (#51207); tokenizers and processors load from the local snapshot (#60825); and with `--api-server-count` above 1 each connection goes to the least-loaded API worker, for 43-85% more req/s on short requests (Qwen3-0.6B, 32 input / 1 output tokens) in the PR's benchmark (#60723).
* **Model support**: new EmbeddingGemma 2 omni-modal embeddings (#60254), MiniCPM-V 4.7 (#58674) and Nemotron 3.5 ASR (#59827); video input in the Transformers modeling backend (#57441); GLM-5.3 sparse MLA index conversions reused across layers (3.5-3.9x on that kernel, #59464) and fused multi-step draft decode (13.3% at concurrency 1, #57443); HiSparse per-request residency caching for up to 58% more throughput on GLM-5.3-NVFP4 on B200 with long, fully GPU-resident contexts at high concurrency (#60083).
* **Security**: fixes for GHSA-4hhp-h66f-j5j7 (chat template resource exhaustion, #50300), GHSA-q97c-p368-75c4 (tokenizer `max_token_id`, #59491) and GHSA-frvg-qw88-hww9 (P2P ZMQ socket exhaustion, #51504); CORS no longer allows every origin by default (#61009); untrusted images are limited to raster formats (#60022); shared-memory multimodal cache handles are signed (#59357); and JSON schemas nested deeper than 64 levels are rejected (#60036).
* **Breaking changes**: Python 3.10 dropped (#60402); default CORS origins restricted (#61009); `transformers>=5.16.1,<5.20.0` and `tokenizers>=0.23.2` (#57387, #59796); torch.compile sequence parallelism and AsyncTP passes removed (#60517); cascade attention removed (#61126); `mamba_cache_mode="all"` removed (#58997); `max_tokens` no longer reserved from the context window (#57035); Responses API reasoning stream events renamed (#59652).

## Release Artifacts

### Python Wheels

| Platform | Install |
|---|---|
| PyPI (CUDA 13.0) | `pip install vllm` |
| PyPI (CUDA 13.0, uv) | `uv pip install vllm --torch-backend=auto` |
| ROCm | `pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/rocm/0.32.0/rocm723` |
| XPU | `uv pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/0.32.0/xpu --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/xpu --index-strategy unsafe-best-match` |

### Docker Images

| Platform | Docker Image |
|---|---|
| CUDA 13.0 (Default) | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0` |
| CUDA 12.9 | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0-cu129` |
| CUDA 13.0 + Ubuntu 24.04 | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0-ubuntu2404` |
| CUDA 12.9 + Ubuntu 24.04 | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0-cu129-ubuntu2404` |
| ROCm | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.32.0` |
| CPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-cpu:v0.32.0` |
| XPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:v0.32.0` |

### Other Artifacts

Pre-built release artifacts are available in the **Assets** section at the bottom of this page, including:
- Source distribution tarball
- CUDA 12.9 Python wheels for x86_64 and arm64
- CUDA 13.0 Python wheels for x86_64 and arm64
- CPU Python wheels for x86_64, arm64, and macOS
- XPU Python wheel for x86_64

## Model Support
* **New models**: EmbeddingGemma 2 (`google/embeddinggemma-2`), an omni-modal text/image/audio/video embedding model, with unused modality encoders skipped through `--limit-mm-per-prompt` (#60254, #60289); MiniCPM-V 4.7 (#58674); Nemotron 3.5 ASR (`nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b`) complete-audio transcription; native realtime streaming is not yet supported (#59827); `Cloudflare/clef-omni` (#61064) and `LiquidAI/d1-3B` (#60676) on `/v1/systemone`; PLaMo 3 reasoning and tool parsers (#56575); and the zerank-2 reranker score template (#60415).
* **Transformers modeling backend**: video inputs (#57441), and Glm, Arcee, CWM, Mellum (#59679), GPT-NeoX, Phi, Seed-OSS and Jais2 (#59701) now served through it.
* **New model capabilities**: LoRA for BERT, RoBERTa and XLM-RoBERTa embedding models (#61033); Granite as an EAGLE3/DFlash target (#60855); Qwen3-ASR EAGLE3 (#52824); Sarvam MLA EAGLE3/DSpark with PP (#55902); GLM-5.3-Flash with the DFlash2 drafter (#56983); and MiniMax-M3 EAGLE3 at PP > 1 on MRV2 (#57197) with MTP sharing target embeddings under PP (#58648).
* **GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash**: sparse MLA index conversion reused across layers (#59464), fused multi-step draft decode (#57443), FP8 KV cache default on SM100 (#60140, #60281), `fp8_ds_mla` on SM90 (#59246), qlnorm skipped for MHA (4.4-7.7% TTFT, #58845), long-context indexer prefill sharded across TP (up to 25% lower TTFT at 1M context, #54951), DCP for the kpool indexer (#59211, #60032), KDA prefill checkpoints with FlashKDA (#56960), FP8 KV on SM90 sparse MLA (#55222), `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype` honored for KDA state (#59147), a generic packed KV layout (#57169), MTP index sharing restored (#61079), and fixes for vision-tower crashes (#59126), non-square image encoder budgets (#59565), DP startup (#56974), video timestamps (#55647), DFlash2/EAGLE3 aux hidden states (#60763) and null-block writes (#59528).

## Security
* GHSA-4hhp-h66f-j5j7: chat templates are validated statically and rendered under a timeout (`VLLM_CHAT_TEMPLATE_RENDER_TIMEOUT`), user-supplied `chat_template` in Responses `chat_template_kwargs` is rejected, and the Rust frontend caps template execution (#50300).
* GHSA-q97c-p368-75c4: tokenizer `max_token_id` off-by-one fixed (#59491).
* GHSA-frvg-qw88-hww9: P2P ZMQ peer sessions are bounded by `VLLM_P2P_MAX_PEERS` (default 128), `VLLM_P2P_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_S` (default 30) and `VLLM_P2P_IDLE_TIMEOUT_S` (default 300), so unique peer addresses can no longer exhaust ZMQ sockets (#51504).
* Default CORS settings no longer allow every origin in the Python and Rust frontends; set `--allowed-origins` to permit browser origins (#61009).
* Untrusted images are opened with a raster-format allowlist (`ALLOWED_IMAGE_FORMATS`), denying EPS/PostScript and WMF (#60022); shared-memory multimodal cache handles are HMAC-signed and forged handles rejected (#59357).
* Structured-output JSON schemas nested more than 64 levels return 400 (#60036); chunked `/v1/embeddings` requests keep `cache_salt` (#47696); Phi-4 MM audio no longer holds multi-GiB attention matrices (#60614); DeepSeek-OCR zero-sum pixel tensors no longer kill EngineCore (#59417).
* Security dependency bumps: `aiohttp>=3.14.3`, `pillow>=12.3.0`, cryptography, urllib3, pyjwt and others (#59249, #59315, #59427).

## Breaking Changes & Deprecations
* Python 3.10 is no longer supported; the minimum is Python 3.11 (#60402).
* Default CORS origins changed from `*` to none; set `--allowed-origins` for browser clients (#61009).
* `transformers>=5.16.1,<5.20.0` and `tokenizers>=0.23.2` are required (#57387, #59796).
* The torch.compile sequence parallelism and AsyncTP passes were removed, along with `PassConfig.enable_sp`, `fuse_gemm_comms` and `sp_min_token_num`; model-level sequence parallelism is unaffected (#60517).
* Cascade attention was removed; `--disable-cascade-attn` still parses but only warns and will be removed in v0.33.0 (#61126).
* `mamba_cache_mode="all"` was removed; `--mamba-cache-mode all` now fails validation (#58997).
* Previously deprecated APIs were removed: `wait_for_inflight_requests` (use `mode="wait"`), `AsyncLLM.pause_generation()`, `IOProcessor.output_to_response`, `vllm.scripts.main()` and `vllm bench throughput --dataset` (#60923). The `sonnet` benchmark dataset was removed as scheduled (#60129). Tensorizer support was removed from LoRA (#60024), and the PyO3 `vllm._rust_tool_parser` bridge was removed (#59744).
* API changes: `max_tokens` is treated as an upper bound on output rather than reserved from the context window (#57035); Responses API streaming uses `response.content_part.added/done` with `part.type="reasoning_text"` instead of `response.reasoning_part.added/done` (#59652); `SamplingParams.prompt_logprob_token_ids` is per row (#56984); `/inference/v1/generate` logprobs use integer token IDs (#58181); sleep API responses are standardized and invalid levels return 400 (#52864); `return_mm_kwargs` is deprecated in favor of `mm_payload` (#61427).
* Watermarking: when the engine has watermarking configured, an omitted request field means enabled and only `false` opts out; unsupported combinations warn and fall back (#56801).
* Rust frontend: `qwen3_xml` now parses Qwen3-Coder XML (alias of `qwen3_coder`); use the new `qwen3_json` for the JSON format (#60136).
* New defaults: shared-memory tensor arena on (#51207); GLM-5.x FP8 KV cache on SM100 with `--kv-cache-dtype auto` (#60140, #60281); `VLLM_DEEPEP_V2_ALLOW_HYBRID_MODE=1` (#57991); Humming preferred over Marlin on SM90 (#56997); `sparse_mla_prefill_workspace_factor` 2 above 256K `max_model_len` (#61023); MRV2 on ROCm with model-specific MRV1 exceptions removed (#56360); `VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MLA_DCP_VERIFY=auto` (#59965); `dtype=auto` picks bfloat16 on PowerPC (#58528); MXFP4 W4A4 checkpoints fall back to W4A16 with a warning when no W4A4 kernel exists (#60079).
* Stricter validation: incompatible `--prefix-match-unit` (#58021), `max_num_scheduled_tokens=0` (#60714), HiSparse with `cudagraph_mode=FULL` (#59688), and negative `--device-ids` (#49053) are rejected at startup.

# v0.31.0

## Highlights

This release features 717 commits from 307 contributors (96 new)!

* **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash performance**: FlashMLA mega attention with the V4.1 NVFP4 compressed KV cache is now the SM100 default (#56935); DeepGEMM sparse MQA logits for the indexer (#56254) and Mega-Gate fusing the gate GEMM with expert selection (#56266); decoder boundaries fuse the TP all-reduce, mHC input preparation (#57643) and the MoE finalize (#58586); a fused small-batch WO-A with inverse RoPE and MXFP8 quant on SM100/SM103 (#58634); the MXFP8 `wo_b` GEMM fused with the sequence-parallel reduce-scatter (#57428); Engram `wkv` sharded across TP ranks (#58678) and Engram host tables shared across co-located DP replicas by default (#57651); encoder CUDA graphs for the vision tower (#56625); and SWA bounded replay that keeps the sliding-window KV out of prefix caching (#56227).
* **Fast restart**: the new `vllm preload` CLI launches the weight-cache daemon that keeps post-quantized weights resident in GPU memory across engine restarts (#56680), now with data parallelism (#57386), MTP draft models (#57312), a `/health` endpoint (#58552) and a readiness wait (#58370). Experimental initialized-engine snapshots (`vllm snapshot create/restore`) use CRIU to restore a fully initialized TP1 engine (#51360).
* **Model Runner V2 and speculative decoding**: draft-model speculative decoding (#43091) and custom logits processors (#56497) on Model Runner V2; the new LiLiCorr drafter (#57934); async scheduling for DFlash (#58065) with the context K/V precompute captured in the draft CUDA graph (#57632); DSpark adaptive verification for Gemma4 (#57263) and variable-length decode for Kimi-K3 (#52988); a DCP target with a non-DCP DSpark draft (#56723); and MoE memory now counted during MRV2 profiling, avoiding OOMs on WideEP deployments (#57270, #58411).
* **Large scale serving**: MoonEP balanced EP all2all backend via `--all2all-backend moonep` (#52101), prefill context parallelism with data parallelism (#57075), a low-SM multimem reduce-scatter for SM100/SM103 (#55072), DeepEPv2 with sequence parallelism (#57210) and EPLB with shared-expert overlap (#57236), a sharding-aware NCCL M2N weight-transfer backend for RL (#51520), and KV offloading back-pressure detection (#50045).
* **Scheduling controls**: `--max-num-active-seqs` caps RUNNING admission independently of `max_num_seqs` (#56758), `--long-prefill-token-threshold` now adapts to the number of waiting prefills instead of chunking a lone request (#57951, #58459), the waiting queue was reworked so requests already holding KV blocks are scheduled first (#58947), and the KV connector + MTP deadlock under KV pressure was fixed (#57104).
* **HiSparse hardening**: MTP verification rows resolved with a union residency kernel (#59235), MTP acceptance collapse under FULL graphs fixed (#59309), no GPU pages without host backing (#59036), a chunked-prefill preemption livelock fixed (#59494), KV cache sized from the groups HiSparse allocates (#59450), and host prefix publication and GPU prefix adoption fixes (#59007, #59282).
* **Security**: per-request `mm_processor_kwargs` and `media_io_kwargs` are rejected unless `--trust-request-mm-kwargs` is set (#58830); prefix-cache extra keys are tagged by source so a LoRA name and a `cache_salt` can no longer collide (#51899), and the LoRA path is part of the block hash (#59335); stale multimodal receiver-cache entries can no longer replace fresh payloads (#57833).
* **Breaking changes**: per-request multimodal kwargs gated (#58830); `tokenizer_mode="slow"` removed (#58545); `--enable-mamba-fine-grained-prefix-cache` renamed to `--enable-mamba-shared-prefix-checkpoint` (#57382); online quantization through `quantization="fp8"` replaced by the `fp8_per_tensor` shorthand (#53585) and Quark silent online quantization removed (#51800); the AllSpark INT8 W8A16 backend removed (#58001); `--enforce-eager` now also disables JIT kernel warmup (#58197); XPU graphs enabled by default with `VLLM_XPU_ENABLE_XPU_GRAPH` removed (#51600).

## Release Artifacts

### Python Wheels

| Platform | Install |
|---|---|
| PyPI (CUDA 13.0) | `pip install vllm` |
| PyPI (CUDA 13.0, uv) | `uv pip install vllm --torch-backend=auto` |
| ROCm | `pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/rocm/0.31.0/rocm723` |
| XPU | `uv pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/0.31.0/xpu --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/xpu --index-strategy unsafe-best-match` |

### Docker Images

| Platform | Docker Image |
|---|---|
| CUDA 13.0 (Default) | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0` |
| CUDA 12.9 | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0-cu129` |
| ROCm | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.31.0` |
| CPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-cpu:v0.31.0` |
| XPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:v0.31.0` |

### Other Artifacts

Pre-built release artifacts are available in the **Assets** section at the bottom of this page, including:
- Source distribution tarball
- CUDA 12.9 Python wheels for x86_64 and arm64
- CUDA 13.0 Python wheels for x86_64 and arm64
- CPU Python wheels for x86_64, arm64, and macOS
- XPU Python wheel for x86_64

## Model Support
* **New model capabilities**: DiffusionGemma structured generation mode with bounded single-token choices (#57250), MiMo V2 MXFP4 MoE, BF16 MoE router and DFlash drafts (#57784), Cohere2MoE auxiliary hidden states for EAGLE3/DFlash drafters (#49819), GLM-5.2-MXFP4 on the ROCm DeepSeek-V3.2 path (#51915), AMD-Quark mixed-precision DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-MXFP4 (#57071) and GLM-5.3-Flash Quark MXFP4 (#56176) checkpoints, and a built-in `granite_thinking_parser` for Granite 4.2 (#55957).
* **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash**: FlashMLA mega attention with the NVFP4 compressed KV cache as the SM100 default (#56935), DeepGEMM sparse MQA logits in the indexer (#56254), Mega-Gate (#56266), fused TP all-reduce + mHC input preparation (#57643) with the MoE finalize folded in (#58586), fused small-batch WO-A (#58634), MXFP8 `wo_b` GEMM + reduce-scatter (#57428), overlapped mHC coefficients for small TP batches (#57603) limited to FULL CUDA graphs (#57874), Engram `wkv` sharded across TP (#58678), serialized Engram lookups with huge-page host tables (#56926), Engram tables shared across DP replicas by default (#57651, #57914, #59068), native shared-expert MegaMoE fusion without padding (#56568, #57204), faster MegaMoE staging and NVFP4 cache gathers (#57604), the fused query RMSNorm + MXFP8 path restored (#57679), KV-only DSpark context insertion (#56441), vision encoder CUDA graphs (#56625, #58499), SWA bounded replay (#56227), causal image SWA restored to match the reference (#57152), updated reasoning effort mappings (#58316), and startup fixes for NaN-scored candidate blocks (#57454), DeepSelect sentinels (#58215), DSpark non-causal attention on FlashInfer (#57432), runtime JIT of offset candidate buffers (#57667) and imports without Triton (#57654).
* **DeepSeek V4**: FlashInfer sparse MLA with fused inverse RoPE + FP8 quant (#58621), stacked DSpark context WKV projections (#54674), fused MoE expert distribution computed from the EP group (#57465), FIM completion via `suffix` (#44229), missing `string=` in tool calls parsed (#56271), request tools attached to an existing system message (#51856), image block spacing preserved (#56882), and DSpark width separated from MTP stage validation (#54631).
* **GLM-5.3-Flash**: opt-in FlashAttention and FlashMLA sparse backends on SM90 (#55385), NoPE sparse MLA on the FlashInfer SM120 backend (#55277), cooperative top-k for small decode batches (#57327), indexer decode workspace sized by pooled length (3 GiB saved, #57701), metadata ops 1.6-4.8x faster (#58450), fused kpool tail slot mapping (#57534), kpool top-k through the shared dispatcher (#57546), lower sparse MLA preparation overhead (#57458), no D2H sync in the SM90 sparse MLA plan under async scheduling (#58684), FlashKDA keeping the recurrent state in FP32 for long prefills (#58846), and correctness fixes for kpool corruption with speculative decoding (#58454), SM90 `index_kpool` mismatch (#58704), kpool tail strides (#57477), 500k-token prompts (#57317), dense MLP layers under sequence parallelism (#58061), indexer top-k backend selection (#58594) and varlen paged MQA launches (#55270).
* **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Qwen4Exp)**: FP8 main KV cache on the QSA path (#55557), FP8 TP with FlashInfer TRTLLM MoE (#55867), SM90 QSA tuning (#57273), fused HC down projection + SiLU (#58957), lower PLE metadata overhead (#58114), QSA indexer workspace fragmentation fixed (#57105), profiling KV cache released (#58961), pinned PLE prefetch ids kept out of the CUDA graph pool (#58489), and indexed expert-mapping lookups saving about 25 s of weight loading on DGX Spark (#58720).
* **Kimi K3 and MiniMax-M3**: Kimi-K3 vision patch embedder as a GEMM (#58527), fused KimiViT QK RoPE (up to 29x, #58651), routed expert quantization (#57430), reasoning parser (#57098) and reasoning token counting (#58372) fixes, DSpark context KV pointers refreshed after re-binding (#58814), stateless first chunks no longer classified as decodes (#51483), and Mamba block estimates that no longer stall admission on external prefix hits (#57050); MiniMax-M3 encoder CUDA graphs (#58673), `Conv3dLayer` patch embedding (about 62x, #58512), `triton_mrope` in the vision tower (#58526), fused MiniMax2 routing with non-unit scaling (#58880), and processor fixes (#58460, #59613).
* **DiffusionGemma**: one-pass sampler statistics kernel (#58226), `diffusion_constrained` reads over `logprob_token_ids` (about 25% faster, #58216), fewer logit rows for prefill-only batches (#57416), `logprob_token_ids` support (#57417), and fixes for concurrent logprobs (#57414), eager fallback dtype (#57462), multimodal inputs (#57589), quantized LM heads (#48521) and CPU execution (#58964).
* **Multimodal**: Triton `mm_input_norm` kernel (#56798, #56711), raw pixels kept through the DP-sharded ViT path (#56872), Qwen2.5-VL video fps honored for temporal M-RoPE (#47736), Whisper and Qwen2-Audio clips longer than 30s (#57769, #56912), Mistral3 placeholder grid (#53758), Idefics3 unsplit patches (#48760), Ovis2.5 tokens (#52623), Aria expert weights (#57487), MiMo-V2.5 fused FP8 `qkv_proj` sharding (#57508), Gemma4 `AutoWeightsLoader` (#55911) and buffer scalars (#54213), Gemma4 FP8 KV with FA4 at head dim 512 (#53175), Laguna RoPE (#57189), Mistral-Large-3 accuracy regression (#57563), malformed EXIF (#56527, #57234), JinaVL labels (#57347), Sarvam MLA routing with FP32 router logits (#56034), fused CohereASR attention scores (#55190), and fused DFlash2 grouped convolution (#55960).
* **LoRA**: Nemotron VL language models (#56231), ModernBert (#57148), VoyageQwen3 embeddings (#57708), RoBERTa sequence classification (#58884), and `modules_to_save` sequence-classification heads (#53555) with per-adapter `num_labels` (#57766).

## Engine Core
* **Model Runner V2**: draft-model speculative decoding (#43091), custom logits processors (#56497) validated at admission (#57728), randomized dummy inputs (#58411), dummy tokens routed to MoE experts during profiling (#57270), FULL decode graphs for one-token prompt tails (#58400), token-to-request mappings shared (#57102) and Mamba/GDN metadata reused across KV cache groups (#58762), encoder-only ViT CUDA graphs (#56922), weight offloader (#57834) and pooling model (#57737) released on shutdown, and fixes for multi-layer MTP KV in P/D (#55055), fast-prefill with LoRA (#56456), stale block-table writes from dummy draft steps (#56734), padded prompt tails in hybrid models (#58434), never-proposed draft slots (#58784), auto-fit `max_model_len` (#58149) and `intermediate_tensors` during capture (#57745).
